question: 2013 年户均现金余额是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(fact_cash_balances.Cash) / COUNT(DISTINCT fact_cash_balances.SK_AccountID) AS average_cash_balance FROM atlas.dwd.fact_cash_balances AS fact_cash_balances INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_cash_balances.SK_DateID = dim_date.SK_DateID WHERE dim_date.CalendarYearID = 2013 LIMIT 100

fibo_concepts.note: 户均现金余额 = 现金余额合计 / 有余额的去重账户数；实测为负（透支账户拉低户均，KL #17 口径锚定，负值 = 发布口径下的正确结果）
